instruction: Candid wide-angle photograph of an indoor studio with a red carpet. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right. On the right, the man in the black cap and dark polo shirt (R1) stands facing left, extending his right arm to touch the woman's (R2) shoulder. The background features white walls and a radiator. Bright overhead lighting casts soft shadows.
